findings.area: Request cancellation and actual player/envelope ownership
findings.assessment: Both inference segments use one request revision and the same cancellation supplier. Checks precede inference and separate EN, DE, joining and return. The original MediaPlayer, generation, active/destroyed, pause/stop/release, measured PCM envelope, actual media-position and system-volume/mute sections are byte-identical. Bilingual result word, en-de language, local flag, profile, preset and sample rate are checked before a player can be prepared; late or replaced generations remain rejected.

The engine joins its own exact mono PCM16/44100-Hz RIFF format, preserving both data payloads with exactly 11025 zero frames (250 ms) between them. Both headers, sample format, block alignment, declared sizes and lengths are checked; the complete joined sequence, including silence, must fit the existing 30-second bound. This is a source-level and contract-design finding, not a claim of successful real English synthesis or heard audio.

The unchanged installer already installs the four speech sources in the existing namespaces. Adding LumoSpeechEnvelope to the compile helper's required tuple closes the identified report dependency without removing any earlier class or build check. findings.assessment: The runner binds actual CI source (same-repository PR head or push SHA), committed input bytes and immutable historical fixture hashes.
